Text & encoding

Change text case, encode URL components, or convert UTF-8 text to and from Base64.

Maximum 200,000 characters. Text is processed in this browser.

Your result

Encoding is not encryption

Base64 represents bytes using printable characters. It does not hide or protect secrets. This tool supports standard padded Base64 and UTF-8 text, including emoji.

URL component encoding is intended for a single value, such as a search parameter. It encodes reserved punctuation, including slashes and question marks. Do not use it to preserve an entire URL unchanged. Decoding leaves plus signs as plus signs.
